pages.title: Start here
pages.summary: How this guide is organised, and what it covers.

blocks.text: This guide covers **Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag Resynced** (the 2026 remake) on PC. It is built from public guides, rewritten in my own words (see Credits).

items.value: Every sequence, with a page per memory: steps, optional extras and tips.
Trackers for viewpoints, shanties, treasure maps, secrets, chests and more, by area.
Templar hunts, side quests, rifts, assassin contracts and officer quests, with steps.
What is in each island or town.
Naval contracts, forts, legendary ships, upgrades and crafting.
Swords, pistols, outfits and trinkets.
Tips by topic, order of play, unlocks and common problems.
Main memories and trophies.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.text: Controls in the walkthrough are given for PlayStation and Xbox controllers; use your own PC bindings. Some details are missing where the sources did not give them: see [Known gaps](page:gaps). The Caribbean map is a picture only, with no pins.

pages.title: Sequence 1: Edward Takes the Robes
pages.summary: Edward takes the identity of a dead Assassin.

blocks.text: Edward takes the identity of a dead Assassin.

pages.title: Edward Kenway
pages.summary: Survive the opening sea battle off Cape Bonavista, wash ashore, defeat the false Brotherhood man Duncan Walpole, and sail out toward Havana.

blocks.text: Survive the opening sea battle off Cape Bonavista, wash ashore, defeat the false Brotherhood man Duncan Walpole, and sail out toward Havana.

items.text: Take the wheel of the ship (the helmsman is dead) and learn naval combat.
Aim the cannons at the five enemy vessels and sink them all.
After being thrown overboard, swim southeast toward the wreckage until the cutscene.
Chase the fleeing man southeast into the island: climb the tree and cross the broken bridge.
Head east to the tall wooden tower (the Viewpoint), climb it and synchronize.
Follow the trail south past the waterfall platform and another broken bridge, then past the southern huts.
Drop into the stream and catch up with Walpole.
Win the duel using lock-on, attacks, parry and dodge; a perfect parry allows a quick takedown.
Take Walpole's robes and the Glass Cube, and read the letter on his body.
After the second Viewpoint, head southwest and free the merchant by clearing the five soldiers (stealth, combat or both).
Swim to the waiting boat to start the sailing tutorial and sail out of the bay toward Havana.
Loot huts along the climb and the skeleton beside the main path.
Dive east near the second Viewpoint to find an easily missed underwater chest.
Island collectibles listed: 2 Viewpoints, 1 Chest, 2 Song Sheets or Shanties, 3 Secrets (some stay locked until a later chapter).
Loot the area before swimming to the boat; the island is locked off later in the story.

blocks.text: Aim at the hull for the most damage in naval combat.
Lowering speed tightens the turning radius and helps close distance.
There is no sprint timer in the chase, so you can explore the island.
Holding the focus button highlights nearby loot and points of interest even before Eagle Vision is unlocked.
Synchronizing the Viewpoint reveals nearby collectibles on the map.
Melee: lock on, keep attacking until a blue spark shows a broken guard, parry timed to the spark, dodge, repeat.
Stealth toolkit: Eagle Vision outlines enemies, the focus button tags them, crouch in bushes, whistle to lure enemies.
Sailing: one press opens the sails partway, a second opens them fully, and the lower-sails button slows you down.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 2: Edward Meets the Templars
pages.summary: A visit to Havana ends with Edward captured, then escaping on a Spanish treasure fleet.

blocks.text: A visit to Havana ends with Edward captured, then escaping on a Spanish treasure fleet.

blocks.label: 4. A Man They Call the Sage

pages.title: Lively Havana
pages.summary: Follow Stede through Havana, survive a tavern brawl and shake off the guards.

blocks.text: Follow Stede through Havana, survive a tavern brawl and shake off the guards.

items.text: Follow Stede through the streets (auto-follow can be cancelled to explore).
At the weapon shop, get a British Cutlass for 800 Reales; Stede pays.
Climb the nearest church and synchronize the Viewpoint, which also reveals a southwest Viewpoint.
Leap of Faith into the haystacks.
Chase and loot the pickpocket to get Stede's coin back; dodge his attack when it flashes red.
Go to the tavern and win the brawl, using a sweep and a kick once each.
When guards arrive, drop a Smoke Bomb, run, and hide in a haystack or get far enough away.

blocks.text: Sweep is R2 + X/A and kick is R2 + square/X; after using each once you can fight freely.
Some Havana Viewpoints and buildings unlock here and matter later.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: ...And My Sugar?
pages.summary: Find Stede near the docks and get back his seized sugar shipment and Edward's belongings.

blocks.text: Find Stede near the docks and get back his seized sugar shipment and Edward's belongings.

items.text: Eavesdrop on the two guards marked with a green ear icon, crouching behind crates or barrels.
After the bell rings, go to the new objective in northeast Havana.
At the gallows, listen in on another conversation to learn that Captain Mendoza carries a key.
Tail Mendoza through the crowd without being spotted.
Skip the front gate; go around the northwest and climb the wooden structure and brickwork to the fort top.
Work through the guards as suggested: split the talking pair, whistle one over and knock him out, then take the second.
Clear the guard watching the water, grab the chest below the white wall, and climb back up.
Hide in the haystack by the Viewpoint, deal with the returning guard, and synchronize the Viewpoint.
Head southeast and pickpocket or knock out the Captain, then clear the last guard to the northeast.
Enter the room, turn right outside it and take the zipline down to Stede, then talk to him.

blocks.text: Eavesdropping: crouch and hold the interact button (triangle/Y); at the gallows hold L2/LT.
Losing Mendoza in the crowd leads to a large group of soldiers.
The northwest route is the cleanest approach.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Mister Walpole, I Presume?
pages.summary: Keep up Edward's disguise as Duncan Walpole in front of the Templars Woodes Rogers and Julien du Casse.

blocks.text: Keep up Edward's disguise as Duncan Walpole in front of the Templars Woodes Rogers and Julien du Casse.

items.text: Go to the house in southwest Havana, speak with the guards outside and go upstairs to meet Rogers and du Casse.
Take Rogers' pistol test: equip pistols, aim and hit all five targets within 30 seconds.
Take du Casse's assassination drills: haystack, wall corner, rush and air assassination in the order prompted.
Meet Torres once the tests are passed.
Torres wants to meet the next day; with no room at the tavern, sleep on the rooftop bench north of it to end the memory.
Pickpocket the three nearby Templars for extra Reales.
Look at the diagram linked to an Observatory.
Read the Wanted Poster for Bartholomew Roberts.

blocks.text: Missing the 30 second pistol timer does not fail the mission.
Walking near the training mannequins can trigger the next drill prompt.
Pistols are equipped with L2/LT + D-pad up, aimed with L2/LT and fired with R2/RT.
Edward also picks up a Curious Schematic.

items.text: Memory complete

blocks.label: Next: A Man They Call the Sage

pages.title: A Man They Call the Sage
pages.summary: Escort Torres and the prisoner Roberts (the Sage) toward Torres' residence while fending off rival Assassins.

blocks.text: Escort Torres and the prisoner Roberts (the Sage) toward Torres' residence while fending off rival Assassins.

items.text: Go northeast to the docks, where Rogers introduces Torres questioning Roberts.
Escort the group toward the residence; rival Assassins ambush you.
Kill attackers with the hidden blade after a perfect parry or a broken guard.
Keep pistols ready for threats on rooftops.
In the last wave the Assassins grab Roberts and flee; chase him to a dead end.
Land a perfect parry for an instant takedown.
With Roberts back in custody, accept Torres' invitation to watch the interrogation.

blocks.text: Shooting the Sage instead of tackling him carries no penalty.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Claiming What's Due
pages.summary: Sneak into Torres' guarded estate at night and reach the prison in the northwest corner.

blocks.text: Sneak into Torres' guarded estate at night and reach the prison in the northwest corner.

items.text: Meet Stede at the southern tavern and share a drink to bring on nightfall.
Throw a Smoke Bomb and slip through the fence gap west of the tavern.
Tag guards with Eagle Vision and assassinate the one nearest the gap.
Separate the two patrol guards with a whistle and lure isolated guards into grass or haystacks.
Double assassinate the pair near the pigs and the well.
Climb to the manor roof to avoid a big cluster of soldiers, and take the rooftop chest and the Viewpoint.
Wait for the Warden to pass the northern edge, drop on him with an air assassination and take his key.
Read du Casse's letter near the northern table.
Go to the west side, vault the wall and unlock the prison door to trigger the next memory.

blocks.text: The roof route avoids the large group of soldiers.

items.text: Memory complete

blocks.label: Previous: A Man They Call the Sage

pages.title: The Treasure Fleet
pages.summary: Escape captivity with Adewale, free captured pirates, take a Brig and command a ship through a storm chase.

blocks.text: Escape captivity with Adewale, free captured pirates, take a Brig and command a ship through a storm chase.

items.text: Free yourself, meet Adewale and clear the deck guards together; recover your gear after knocking out the nearby guard.
Move from ship to ship, taking down soldiers and freeing pirates.
On the last ship go below deck; double assassinate the first pirate pair, take the other two guards one at a time and free the last prisoners.
Jump to the smaller vessel and assassinate its captain to take command.
In the storm chase, aim explosive barrels, launch them and detonate them.
Brace against damage, steer straight into rogue waves, and avoid lightning and tornadoes.
Head east; Adewale becomes quartermaster as the memory ends.

blocks.text: Barrels: aim with L2/LT, launch with R2/RT, detonate with R1/RB; brace with square/X.
Each ship can be done stealthily or openly, but Adewale is not always nearby.
Holding attack makes a heavy attack.
Heavy guards appear for the first time here.
Being spotted on one ship does not alert the others.
Climbing the rigging lets you drop onto guards below.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 3: Building the Jackdaw
pages.summary: Edward builds up his ship, crew and reputation, and takes control of Great Inagua.

blocks.text: Edward builds up his ship, crew and reputation, and takes control of Great Inagua.

pages.title: This Tyro Captain
pages.summary: Sail to Abaco Island to find a shipwright and get a pistol holster for Edward.

blocks.text: Sail to Abaco Island to find a shipwright and get a pistol holster for Edward.

items.text: Sail to Abaco Island, using Pathfinder or steering by hand.
Pick up loot and stranded crew on the way.
Anchor and slide down a rope into the water.
Synchronize the island's single Viewpoint and go to the camp.
Investigate the camp, which points to local Ocelots as the cause of the damage.
Track the Ocelots east using your vision.
Skin the Ocelots for 2 Ocelot Pelts.
Craft a Pistol Holster in the crafting menu.
Return to the ship and talk to Adewale, who gives Edward a second pistol.
Let the Ocelots attack and parry on the blue flash; two quick parries earn the Double Tap trophy.

blocks.text: Pathfinder: hold up on the D-pad, then press triangle/Y.
Abaco is small enough to clear in one visit, a good early stop for location completion.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Now Hiring
pages.summary: Free captured pirates in Nassau to build up the crew.

blocks.text: Free captured pirates in Nassau to build up the crew.

items.text: In September 1715 sail to Nassau and dock at the Old Avery tavern.
Follow Anne Bonny toward the gallows.
Head southeast to free nearby pirates and climb the tower for Nassau's Viewpoint.
Fight the two soldiers guarding the gallows, which teaches quickfire.
After freeing that pair, go north where a woman points out a man about to be hanged.
Shoot the rope, clear the soldiers and revive him.
Return to the Old Avery and talk to James Kidd about the Observatory.

blocks.text: A data file sits on the south side of the tavern.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Prizes and Plunder
pages.summary: Learn from Benjamin Hornigold how to plunder ships.

blocks.text: Learn from Benjamin Hornigold how to plunder ships.

items.text: Speak with Hornigold at the campfire on Nassau's northern edge.
Learn the spyglass and use it to scout schooners.
Open with a cannon volley, then use the swivel gun on the red markers.
Disable the schooner rather than sink it, close in and board.
Learn the wall takedown, which kicks enemies off ship and structure edges during boarding.
Sail southwest to Salt Key Bank and pay 1,000 Reales at the Harbour Master to upgrade the Jackdaw's hull.
Synchronize the Viewpoint near the Harbour Master.

blocks.text: Spyglass is held R3 / F; the swivel gun is aimed then fired with R1/RB.
Slowing down helps when closing in to board.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Raise the Black Flag
pages.summary: Hunt brigs for Metal and upgrade the Jackdaw's cannons.

blocks.text: Hunt brigs for Metal and upgrade the Jackdaw's cannons.

items.text: Talk to Hornigold again in Salt Key Bank.
Hunt brigs, marking targets with the spyglass; at least two ships must go down to collect the 70 Metal.
Return to Salt Key Bank and pay the local officer 400 Reales to lower your bounty.
Upgrade the cannons at the Harbour Master.

blocks.text: Strong winds can damage the Jackdaw, so steer against them.
Brigs ram; open the sails to outrun them or brace to cut damage.
Lower speed and sails to tighten the turn in close fights.
Throw powder barrels from the stern and shoot them; dropping one while fleeing can catch a chasing brig.
The swivel gun works well on barrels or for hull damage.
Cutting the enemy flag during boarding lowers their morale faster.
Attacking brigs raises your Wanted Level and draws Pirate Hunters.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sugarcane and Its Yields
pages.summary: Rob a plantation on Cat Island together with James Kidd.

blocks.text: Rob a plantation on Cat Island together with James Kidd.

items.text: Meet Kidd on the western shore of Andreas Island and get new gear.
Synchronize the Viewpoint to the southwest.
Try hanging soldiers from tree branches, a preview of the Rope Dart.
Follow Beckford's agent to the south into the trees and deal with the guard there (hang or assassinate).
Kill the agent and loot the Endeavour Cargo Manifest from him.
Sail southeast to Cat Island.

Clear the plantation; the key is south of the main warehouse. Suggested route: eavesdrop on the warehouse guards, sabotage the northern bell, loot the chest outside, lure and assassinate guards on the eastern beach and southwestern grass, climb to the southern Viewpoint and sabotage the western bell, clear the watchtower.
Double assassinate the pair outside, climb to the balcony chest, then from the roof pickpocket Beckford for the key or double assassinate from above.
Clear the rest of the guards, collect Cat Island collectibles and plunder the warehouse.
Collect all Cat Island collectibles before plundering (summary table: 1 Viewpoint, 2 Chests, 1 Secret, Howler Monkey).

blocks.text: The Rope Dart trophy The Hangman needs 10 Rope Dart kills.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Proper Defenses
pages.summary: Answer Thatch's worry about crew defenses by stealing a Galleon.

blocks.text: Answer Thatch's worry about crew defenses by stealing a Galleon.

items.text: Sail south from Cat Island to Salt Lagoon in the Gibara region.
Synchronize the Viewpoint at the far end of the nearby shipwreck, which reveals a Treasure Map and an underwater chest.
Speak with Kidd and Thatch to the east.
Receive Heated Shot for the Jackdaw and test it on nearby wrecks.
Find El Arca del Maestro to the northeast near Eleuthera.
Do not attack the galleon directly; tail it from a distance.
Fight off the smaller Spanish ships that attack afterward, using Heated Shot and explosive barrels.
Pay down your raised Wanted Level.

blocks.text: Switch ammo with triangle/Y and fire with R2/RT.
Bad weather can disrupt Pathfinder, so use the spyglass.
Wanted Level can be paid off at Havana, Salt Key Bank, Andreas Island or Nassau.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: A Single Madman
pages.summary: Track down and kill Julien du Casse on Great Inagua.

blocks.text: Track down and kill Julien du Casse on Great Inagua.

items.text: Sail to Great Inagua and go north through broken bridges, ruins and soldier patrols, using bushes and the Rope Dart.
Both forks of the path meet near soldiers questioning a prisoner.
Continue north past a camp of easily distracted soldiers toward a distant house.
From a nearby branch tag as many guards as you can, then take them down one at a time.
Go through a broken window and a portrait room.
Head to the wheel where a chest waits.
Loop back and free the captive pirates guarded by one soldier; a Viewpoint is just behind them.
Board the ship where du Casse hides.
Stealth kill him or fight him.
A Perfumed Note and a letter titled "Standards are Slipping" can be found in the portrait room.

blocks.text: Ignite red barrels and lure him close.
Distract him to flank instead of approaching head-on.
Use ranged attacks and the ammunition on the ship; his movement makes pure melee unreliable.
Dodge or roll when the loading icon above his head fills, because he fires both pistols.
Smoke Bombs help close the distance.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 4: Tulum and the Sage
pages.summary: Edward arrives at Tulum and learns more about the Sage and the Observatory.

blocks.text: Edward arrives at Tulum and learns more about the Sage and the Observatory.

pages.title: This Old Cove
pages.summary: Edward sets up Kidd's old hideout as a home base, which later grows into Great Inagua.

blocks.text: Edward sets up Kidd's old hideout as a home base, which later grows into Great Inagua.

items.text: Follow Kidd to the ancient stone pillars after waking up.
Use vision to spot the ground markings, then climb the pillars and interact with them to reveal the markings.
Rotate and shrink each marking until it lines up under its matching pillar.
Dig at the glowing spot that appears to get the first Mayan Stone.
Follow Kidd into the manor and interact with the stacked chests near the entrance.
Go upstairs to the locked cage of Templar armor and use the Templar Key from du Casse.
Meet the butler to unlock the manor upgrades, side quests and Fleet Planning.
Talk to Kidd at the docks, then take rations to the Tavern for Adewale.
Speak with Adewale at the Tavern to unlock Officer Quests and the Dark Animus.

blocks.text: Interact with the chests before going upstairs.
Each remaining Templar key is tied to a Templar Hunt, and the page says four more keys are needed.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Nothing Is True...
pages.summary: Edward sails to Tulum in the Conttoyor region and works through the jungle to find Kidd.

blocks.text: Edward sails to Tulum in the Conttoyor region and works through the jungle to find Kidd.

items.text: Sail southwest of Havana to Tulum and dock the Jackdaw.
Skip the wooden structure and climb the shipwreck viewpoint.
Use Observe to tag the patrolling soldiers.
Kill the beach guard, then a second patrol guard to the south.
Loop west around the wreck to find a chest in a small opening.
Go north and lure the group of about four soldiers one at a time from the bushes by whistling.
Continue west through the ruins, using bush cover; the east route has a gunner.
Use tree branches to go northwest past the waterfall guards, including a brute.
Head east along the trees until an Assassin ally deals with the soldiers.
Talk to Kidd, then follow him into the Mayan Temple.

blocks.text: Bushes and tree branches give good cover.
Whistle-luring works well on the group of four.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: The Sage's Buried Secret
pages.summary: A mostly platforming and puzzle memory inside a Mayan Temple that ends with Edward receiving the Blowpipe.

blocks.text: A mostly platforming and puzzle memory inside a Mayan Temple that ends with Edward receiving the Blowpipe.

items.text: Follow Kidd until the bridge collapses.
Climb the branches on the northern wall, watching where light hits to find handholds.
At the last branch, jump to the red block and wait for it to lower, then repeat with the blue block to open the door.
In the next room, rotate the dial so the red section is under the red block, then step on the block to drop it.
Pass the room with the broken mechanism, dive and swim southeast, breathe at the air pocket, then swim northeast.
In the final puzzle, use the unmarked counterweight blocks to lift and move the misplaced red and blue blocks.
Rotate the dial to line up each colour and step on each block to slot it in, finishing with green.
Take the Blowpipe from Kidd once the door opens.

blocks.text: Align the dial colour before stepping on a block.
There is an air pocket in the underwater section.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Overrun and Outnumbered
pages.summary: Edward frees nine prisoners from a soldier-held camp using the new Blowpipe, then opens the temple door with the Mayan Stone.

blocks.text: Edward frees nine prisoners from a soldier-held camp using the new Blowpipe, then opens the temple door with the Mayan Stone.

items.text: Free the first prisoner just north of the temple exit, with Kidd helping to clear nearby soldiers.
Cross branches east, assassinate the guard below and take out the gunner on a building.
Cross the northwest branches to reach two guards near two prisoners and use the Blowpipe or stealth.
Climb a tree to the east and use a rope to reach the guard watching a prisoner by a campfire.
Climb the southern wall, cross the pillars and drop down to clear the guard between them.
Double assassinate the two guards holding two more prisoners to the east.
Climb a nearby building and sync the viewpoint to tag the remaining guards and prisoners.
Dive into the water to clear guards near two more prisoners, then go northeast to a lone guarded prisoner.
Sneak through bushes toward the huts to the south to deal with a gunner and two soldiers at a campfire.
Free the last prisoner to the east with a double assassination of its two guards.
Find Kidd east of the area near the pigeon coop to unlock Assassin Contracts.
Return to the temple and place the Mayan Stone from This Old Cove into the door.

blocks.text: The viewpoint tags enemies and prisoners for the rest of the mission.
The Blowpipe takes guards out quietly.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 5: Mary Read Reveals Herself
pages.summary: Edward chases the Sage through Torres and Prins, and Kidd's true identity comes out (the sequence title says it is Mary Read).

blocks.text: Edward chases the Sage through Torres and Prins, and Kidd's true identity comes out (the sequence title says it is Mary Read).

pages.title: The Forts
pages.summary: Edward learns how fort sieges work by taking Fort Punta Guarico and confronting Torres.

blocks.text: Edward learns how fort sieges work by taking Fort Punta Guarico and confronting Torres.

items.text: Go to the Old Avery Tavern in Nassau and meet Thatch.
Return to the Jackdaw and sail south to Fort Punta Guarico.
Clear the enemy fleet first, repairing the Jackdaw with damaged ships if needed.
Avoid the orange rings in the water that mark incoming mortar shots.
Hit the two defence towers with cannons, then use the swivel gun once in range.
Dock and assault the fort, breaking morale by killing soldiers and igniting red powder barrels or crates.
Break down the War Room door at the top to face Torres.
Zipline south to the Jackdaw and enter the cabin to unlock Kenway's Fleet.

blocks.text: Clearing the fleet first makes the second tower easier.
Treat this fort as a template, since later forts are harder.
Stealth is not an option here.
The page says early fort captures clear map fog, open fast travel and unlock Kenway's Fleet regions.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Traveling Salesman
pages.summary: Edward follows Kidd through Kingston to learn where the Sage is and how Torres and Prins connect.

blocks.text: Edward follows Kidd through Kingston to learn where the Sage is and how Torres and Prins connect.

items.text: Sail southwest to Kingston and follow Kidd to the auction yard.
When Kidd stops on a rooftop, cross the beam and drop into the leaves below.
Take out the three patrolling guards quietly using the bushes.
Check the note to the east and investigate the bloodstain further north.
Continue north, clear two guards, loot a chest and read the letter from Torres on the desk.
Go to the cemetery where Kidd waits, with an optional detour west to sync a viewpoint.
Dive off and find Kidd on a rooftop to the southwest.
Follow him into the grass and watch Prins and Torres talk, then fight the guards when it goes wrong.
Chase Kidd after his Smoke Bomb escape and tackle him.
Sync the windmill-area and cemetery viewpoints.
Collect the data file by climbing the cemetery from the east side.

blocks.text: Use bushes to deal with the three guards quietly.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Unmanned
pages.summary: The longest memory of the sequence: Edward infiltrates the guarded plantation manor in Kingston to assassinate Laurens Prins.

blocks.text: The longest memory of the sequence: Edward infiltrates the guarded plantation manor in Kingston to assassinate Laurens Prins.

items.text: Go to the western side of Kingston, climb the Windmill, sync its viewpoint and talk to Kidd.
Sabotage the first alarm bell after tagging guards, dropping into the haystack and following Kidd for a double takedown.
Sabotage the second bell by heading west, clearing the tower gunner and the guards below.
Sabotage the third bell by heading north, prioritising the watchtower gunner and dealing with the brute at the bell.
Regroup with Kidd, enter the manor gate and tag all guards before picking a route.
Clear two patrol guards, climb the ladder and deal with two roof gunners.
Assassinate a guard on the south side of the roof, then a brute to the north.
Jump through the window to find the Laurens Prins Portrait, a trinket and loot.
Climb outside to clear two guards in a separate room and take a letter and a chest.
Work down the corridor floor by floor, clearing guards and looting.
Clear the guards near the final bell and assassinate Prins.
After the cutscene, outrun the soldiers southeast to the Windmill and meet Kidd.
Collect the data files and letters found in the auction yard, cemetery and manor.

blocks.text: Tag guards with Eagle Vision before every route.
Staying with Kidd works as well as splitting up.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 6: Blackbeard's Last Campaign
pages.summary: Blackbeard and Edward work together to get medicine for Nassau.

blocks.text: Blackbeard and Edward work together to get medicine for Nassau.

pages.title: Diving for Medicines
pages.summary: Nassau has a medicine shortage, so Edward gets a Diving Bell and explores his first underwater shipwreck.

blocks.text: Nassau has a medicine shortage, so Edward gets a Diving Bell and explores his first underwater shipwreck.

items.text: Return to Nassau and hear Hornigold and Blackbeard explain the shortage.
Visit the nearest Harbourmaster and buy the Diving Bell for 5,000 Reales.
Sail to the San Ignacio Wreck in the Dry Tortuga region, where Thatch waits.
Dive with the Diving Bell and collect floating air barrels to manage the air meter.
Get carried by currents into a cave with a shark, watching the threat indicator.
Collect the medicine.
Return to the Diving Bell and surface.
Grab the Hull Armor Ultimate Ship Plan from a chest.

blocks.text: Stay close to air barrels in the cave section.
Completing this memory unlocks all seven Underwater Shipwrecks, so there is no rush to do them.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Devil's Advocate
pages.summary: Blackbeard attacks a British Man o' War alone, and Edward must rescue him and help win the fight.

blocks.text: Blackbeard attacks a British Man o' War alone, and Edward must rescue him and help win the fight.

items.text: Find Hornigold's damaged schooner and learn Blackbeard has gone after a Man o' War.
Sail toward Mariguana Island, handling the Jackdaw in strong winds.
Find Blackbeard's ship, Queen Anne's Revenge, docked nearby and rescue survivors in the water.
Dock at the island and clear the soldiers around Blackbeard.
Board the Queen Anne's Revenge and take command.
Fight the Man o' War, closing to a tight angle and using chain shot to slow it.
Ram when chances come up.
Defeat the enemy captain to finish.
Rescue survivors in the water.
Capture Royal Navy frigates in the area for Kenway's Fleet.

blocks.text: Close the distance and use chain shot rather than trading fire at range.
Smoke Bombs help against grouped soldiers on the island.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: The Siege of Charles-Towne
pages.summary: Edward goes to Charles-Towne, South Carolina, to get the key to the medical stockpile for Nassau.

blocks.text: Edward goes to Charles-Towne, South Carolina, to get the key to the medical stockpile for Nassau.

items.text: Sail into Charles-Towne's harbour and follow a rowboat, keeping clear of the watchtowers.
Follow the rowboat to its landing point.
Find and kill the Charles-Towne Captain before he raises the alarm.
Take the key to the medical stockpile and secure the medicine.

blocks.text: Keep a careful distance while tailing the rowboat so you are not detected.

items.text: Memory complete

pages.title: Sequence 7: Nassau Falls
pages.summary: Woodes Rogers arrives with a pardon and military force, and the pirate settlement of Nassau collapses.

blocks.text: Woodes Rogers arrives with a pardon and military force, and the pirate settlement of Nassau collapses.

pages.title: We Demand a Parlay
pages.summary: Shadow Hornigold and Rogers, then lift the fort plans from the fortress in northeast Nassau (coords 606, 766).

blocks.text: Shadow Hornigold and Rogers, then lift the fort plans from the fortress in northeast Nassau (coords 606, 766).

items.text: Follow Hornigold and Rogers over the rooftops to the tavern.
Once they leave, talk to Anne Bonny, who points you to the plans.

pages.title: Trophy roadmap
pages.summary: What order to play in for the trophies and what to avoid.

items.text: Step 1 (about 15-20 h): finish the story, ideally on the lowest difficulty, and start the luck-based trophies early.
Step 2 (about 20-30 h): collectibles, after the story when every area is open.
Step 3 (about 1-2 h): clean up leftover combat and minigame trophies.
Start Kenway's Fleet early for Dilettante: run 5 Brigs and 5 Schooners and recruit Brigs from hard-difficulty regions.
Save manually before accepting fleet reports and reload until a Brig mission rewards an Art Piece.
For Last To Leave, farm Burning Ship events at the Black Trench in Castillo de Jagua, reloading and fast travelling to respawn them.
Hang enemies from trees early for The Hangman because warehouse enemies take hours to respawn.
Avoid Frigate and Man-o-War fleet missions: they give no Art Pieces.
Do not reload saves to farm Hangman kills; the page says that does not work.
Do not skip the officers: they give passive ship bonuses and unlock Return The Favor and Old Ironsides.
Money sources: forts, underwater shipwreck chests, Man-o-War Captain's Lockboxes, Schooner trade missions.
Capture forts and fully upgrade the Harbourmaster before attempting Ship This.
Leave Devil of the Caribbean for last, after Ultimate Plans upgrades and all officers; commenters say lower naval difficulty helps (unconfirmed by the page).
Some commenters say Gun-kata fails for them; the guide's methods are a fallback.

pages.title: Beginner tips
pages.summary: 10 tips

items.text: Nothing is missable, and you can fast travel anywhere after the story, so there is no need to rush collectibles.
Mission replay is gone. Make a manual save at the start of each Sequence; there are 20 manual slots.
Resist the Cape Bonavista chests and Havana side activities right at the start.
Upgrade the Great Inagua hideout as soon as it opens; it raises passive income and unlocks more Jackdaw upgrades.
Aim to have 21,000 reales by Sequence 3 using Assassin missions, early island chests and surplus rum and sugar.
Recruit officers once Great Inagua is fully unlocked, through the officer quests in the mission menu.
Disable the HUD and sail with no destination for a relaxed look at the open sea.
Do not button-mash in melee; parry and perfect dodge instead.
Hunt animals in new areas and use pelts to raise carrying capacity; upgrade pistols first.
Hold D-Pad Down to throw money; it has no tutorial and draws guards and civilians toward it.

pages.title: Combat
pages.summary: 9 tips

items.text: Watch for the blue flash before an enemy swings, then parry with LB/L1 to open them for a counter or instant kill.
A perfect parry breaks defence and sets up a Hidden Blade takedown.
The leg sweep skips the stun bar for an instant kill.
Near walls or on a boarded ship, kick guards away or pull them in with the rope dart.
Chain takedowns can hit up to four nearby enemies, depending on the sword.
Brutes and Demolitionists need Quick Shots or the Rope Dart.
Against El Tiburon, melee and quick-fired pistol shots will not break his defence; aim the pistol manually.
Carry plenty of Remedies for long fights because checkpoints are sparse.
Mark enemies in Eagle Vision with RT/R2 to keep tracking them afterwards.

pages.title: Stealth and notoriety
pages.summary: 14 tips

items.text: Observe from a high safe spot first: tag guards, find alarm bells and patrol routes, and plan your exit before the first kill.
Sweep rooftops and towers too, since one untagged gunner can ruin a route.
When a guard starts to notice you, stop and break line of sight; pushing on turns suspicion into an alarm.
You can crouch anywhere on land. Crouch-walking is far quieter than running at enemies.
Darkness lowers detection but does not hide you from close guards.
Use the Sleep Dart on a lone blocker and the Berserk Dart on a tough enemy inside a group, then leave.
Use a Smoke Bomb when a detection meter is about to fill, then break line of sight rather than fighting in the smoke.
Sabotage alarm bells during your scouting sweep. If a guard starts ringing one, interrupt immediately; killing a ringer enables Silence Fool.
Three or more civilians around you hide you; leaving the group exposes you at once.
Whistle to lure guards off patrol and remove them one at a time.
Tailing is more forgiving than the original: being spotted no longer fails the mission outright.
Throwing money costs 10 reales; throw it away from your route.
Stealth difficulty (Forgiving, Intended, Hard) can be set separately from other difficulty settings.
Dive Anywhere lets you swim under deck-level sightlines; surface somewhere hidden, not under a lookout.

pages.title: Ship combat
pages.summary: 12 tips

items.text: Upgrade the ship whenever you can; storage upgrades raise ammo capacity.
Check a naval contract's recommended difficulty first; Man-o'-War ships can overwhelm an underpowered Jackdaw.
Fully upgrade the Jackdaw before taking on the four legendary ships.
Once combat starts you cannot leave the wheel or fast travel; fight or sail away.
Aim direction picks the weapon: forward chain shot, backward fire barrels, sides broadsides.
Firing exposes red weak points; hit them with the Swivel Gun for explosions that quickly drain enemy HP.
Press L1+R1 head-on to ram, and check your own hull first.
Brace with Square/X before projectiles land to cut damage.
Avoid fighting in storms, steer clear of tornadoes, and face rogue waves head-on.
Mark ships with the spyglass to see their cargo; boarding takes everything, sinking only part, so sink small fleet ships and board the bigger ones.
After boarding choose repair (free, uses captured materials), lower wanted level, or send the ship to Kenway's Fleet.
If naval combat is too hard you can lower its difficulty in settings.

pages.title: Money and resources
pages.summary: 10 tips

items.text: Conquer forts early: they give materials and money and open the sea map for Kenway's Fleet.
Send Schooners on fleet missions for money and Brigs for materials.
Underwater shipwreck chests give a lot of money.
Boarding Man-o-Wars in hard regions and taking the captain's lockbox pays about 5,500 each time.
Use the scope to find ships carrying the material you lack.
Spend money on ship upgrades rather than costly shop materials.
After the Great Inagua manor opens, assassin and naval contracts give steady income and ship materials.
Total cost for every Jackdaw upgrade is about 315,800 reales, 4,755 metal, 2,750 wood, 550 cloth and 12 Ultimate Plans.
Talk to Ade and follow the objective to get the Diving Bell free, saving 5,000 reales.
Twelve Ultimate Plans come from shipwrecks (six) and treasure maps (six).

pages.title: Exploration and map
pages.summary: 8 tips

items.text: Syncing a viewpoint marks nearby collectibles on the map; portraits only appear when you get near.
Conquering forts unfogs the sea map; sailing to an island unlocks fast travel there.
D-Pad Down on the map filters collectibles by type.
Viewpoint fast travel puts you on the spot; named locations always drop you at their dock; the Jackdaw has its own live fast travel point.
Hold D-Pad Right while standing still to skip between day and night; it fails near NPCs, combat or restricted areas.
Skipping time does not speed up manor money or Kenway's Fleet cooldowns.
Small out-of-the-way islands hold hidden chests, Mayan Stelae, Animus Fragments and rare materials.
Switch to daytime when hunting collectibles; night and rain make the game dark.

pages.title: Missables and locked content
pages.summary: 7 tips

items.text: Underwater wrecks, the Blue Hole and Kabah Ruins open after Sequence 6 Mission 1 (Diving for Medicines).
Northern Tulum opens after Sequence 4 Mission 3 (The Sage's Buried Secret).
Isla Providencia opens during or after Sequence 8 Mission 3 (Marooned).
Principe opens during or after Sequence 9 Mission 2 (Trust is Earned).
Long Bay opens during or after Sequence 10 Mission 3 (The Observatory).
Some viewpoint regions are locked: Serranilla until Sequence 8, Principe until 9, Charlotte until 10.
Some new missions are saved for after the main story.

pages.title: Differences from the original
pages.summary: 9 tips

items.text: Collectible locations moved or are new, so older guides' coordinates will not apply.
Combat is parry-driven and faster than the original's counter system; the Hidden Blade is no longer a selectable weapon.
The Rope Dart arrives around Sequence 3 instead of 11.
Edward can crouch anywhere, and an optional Advanced Parkour toggle adds side and back ejects.
Edward can swim and dive anywhere on the open sea; Legendary Ships are replayable.
Multiplayer, the Abstergo office sections and Freedom Cry are gone; modern-day Rifts replace the office sections.
Officers tie to ship abilities: the Padre gives ram dash, Lucy Baldwin perfect brace, Deadman Smith a mortar and extra volley.
Kenway's Fleet unlocks per region after capturing that region's fort.
Added: photo mode, pets on the Jackdaw, and new hideout upgrades.

pages.title: Common problems and fixes
pages.summary: 7 tips

items.text: If PC cutscenes lock to 30 FPS, reset the Overall Preset and avoid setting Raytracing, BVH or Terrain Quality to Ultra High.
Known issue: upgrading the Jackdaw while docked may make it vanish, so avoid doing it mid-quest.
Opening and closing the save menu quickly can strand you on the desynchronization screen.
Desynchronizing and respawning during Devil's Eye Caverns can trap you in the Diving Bell.
Fast travel out of Principe was reported unavailable.
Stray from the path in The One with the Gun and you can get stuck on a branch.
Patches since launch fixed several soft-locks, so install the latest update.

pages.title: Planning and unlocks
pages.summary: When to do what, and what unlocks at which point.

items.text: Skip the Cape Bonavista chests and Havana side activities at the very start (Red Bull guide).
Aim for 21,000 reales by Sequence 3 via Assassin missions, island chests and selling surplus rum and sugar (Red Bull guide).
Upgrade Great Inagua as soon as it opens, then recruit officers (Red Bull guide).
Start capturing low-difficulty forts near Great Inagua, Nassau and Salt Key Bank; naval fort capture is available from Sequence 5 Memory 1 (Red Bull guide).
PowerPyx suggested post-story order: forts, sail to all islands, underwater shipwrecks, remaining cleanup, then legendary ships.

pages.title: Templar hunt: Rhona Dinsmore
pages.summary: Unlocks after the main mission This Old Cove. Rhona is at the Assassin's Bureau on the southeast edge of Havana; you hear fighting before the marker appears. Speaking to her starts the first mission.

items.value: Unlocks after the main mission This Old Cove. Rhona is at the Assassin's Bureau on the southeast edge of Havana; you hear fighting before the marker appears. Speaking to her starts the first mission.
One Templar Key, dropped by the final target Hilary Flint. The last mission ends with a report back to Rhona at the Bureau.

items.text: Defend the Bureau against three waves of soldiers coming through three entrances.
Before a wave, pick up the powder kegs in the courtyard and carry them to the entrances.
Shoot a keg when guards bunch up at an entrance to clear several at once.
Finish off survivors with swords and pistols.
Survive all three waves to complete the mission.

blocks.text: Health and ammo sit on the tables in front of the Bureau.
Kegs are optional, but one shot can kill several soldiers.
Sources differ on whether Rhona places a keg every round or only between waves.

items.text: Find Rhona on a stone pergola roof in northwest Havana and talk to her.
Go northeast to the market and use Eagle Vision to spot two glowing merchants; talk to both.
Sit on a nearby bench until the thief appears and runs.
Chase him; he ends up at a dead end near stairs and a patio and fights.
Defeat him and loot the body for the Pickpocketed Map, which reveals three gunpowder stores.
Clear any wanted level, then report back to Rhona at the Bureau.

blocks.text: He is slow, so catching him is easy; wait at the dead end if you fall behind.
The mission will not complete while you are wanted.

items.text: Destroy three gunpowder reserves shown on the map.
Reserve 1 (northeast, between buildings): deal with the rooftop sniper, then shoot the barrel from a rooftop; the other source says to double-assassinate the two guards in front and ignite it.
Reserve 2 (northwest, under a pergola): remove the two rooftop snipers with rooftop takedowns or the Rope Dart, double-assassinate the guards at the barrel, then ignite it.
Reserve 3 (further northwest, in an alcove): guards and snipers cover it; whistle guards over one at a time from bushes, or drop in behind the awning, then ignite it.
If there is no clean approach, detonate a barrel by hand and run clear.

blocks.text: Blast damage close to a barrel is heavy, so get away after igniting.
The Jackdaw can take damage in the missions before Flint's End.

items.text: Find Rhona on a dockside rooftop and follow her across the rooftops to the docks.
She drops down and draws the guards around Hilary Flint.
Once guards converge on her, drop down and mark Flint with Eagle Vision.
Flint retreats to the pier and shoots from range; close in and fight with swords.
Hold the interact button beside his body to confirm the kill (Templar Key).
Watch the cutscene and return to Rhona at the Bureau to close the hunt.

blocks.text: An explosive barrel on the pier next to him gives a faster kill.

pages.title: Templar hunt: Anto
pages.summary: Anto is inside the Assassin's Bureau in Kingston; speak to him to begin. gamingpromax says the hunt only unlocks after the main mission A Governor No Longer; games.gg lists no prerequisite.

items.value: Anto is inside the Assassin's Bureau in Kingston; speak to him to begin. gamingpromax says the hunt only unlocks after the main mission A Governor No Longer; games.gg lists no prerequisite.
One Templar Key, dropped by the final target Kenneth Abraham; return to Anto at the Bureau to close the hunt.

items.text: Enter the Kingston tavern and take the Notice of Dismissal from the desk.
It points to a nearby church; listen to the guards there, who then scatter.
One guard walks off alone to the left, two go right; follow the lone one.
Catch and tackle him, then question him.
Report back to Anto at the Bureau.

blocks.text: Going left at the church is easier than chasing the pair.

items.text: Follow Anto to the area before entering the guarded zones.
Optionally hire the nearby drunkards for 150 Reales so they draw guards' attention.
Visit the three green markers and kill the guards holding each group of prisoners; aerial assassinations from rooftops work.
After all three are freed, spot the guard officer with Eagle Vision (green marker over his head).
Hide in a haystack and whistle guards over one by one, saving the officer for last.
Go south to the cemetery to meet Anto, then return to the Bureau.

blocks.text: The drunkards pull several guards away from you.

items.text: Talk to Anto at the Bureau; soldiers attack at once.
Hold the Bureau through three waves (the second harder, the third the final push).
Use the healing items and ammo stocked inside between waves.
Check the rooftop, since the last enemy of the final wave tends to stay there.
Afterwards speak to Anto; he sends you to meet him at the marketplace for the final mission.

blocks.text: Look at the rooftops before assuming a wave is over.

items.text: Tail the officers in the marketplace to a restricted party area.
Listen to the officers at the entrance: Kenneth Abraham is near the buffet in the north.
Sit in a bush, whistle a guard over, kill him, then move to the next bush, working north.
Use the same trick to lure Kenneth into a bush and kill him there to avoid a full alert.
If you lose him, use Eagle Vision near the buffet to reveal his marker.
Collect the Templar Key and return to Anto at the Bureau.

blocks.text: Stealth is easiest here but not required.

pages.title: Templar hunt: Vance Travers
pages.summary: Unlocks after This Old Cove. The hunt is listed as Upton Travers, but it begins when you speak to his brother Vance, outside a small wooden house on the south coast of Eleuthera, Nassau.

items.value: Unlocks after This Old Cove. The hunt is listed as Upton Travers, but it begins when you speak to his brother Vance, outside a small wooden house on the south coast of Eleuthera, Nassau.
Third Templar Key per the sources, dropped by the final target Jing Lang; report to Upton to close the hunt.

items.text: Head north to the market and enter the marked Explore area.
Use Eagle Vision to spot Upton's men (green).
Tail them to the hideout, or fight them; killing them shrinks the search area.
Follow the marker west to the hideout, where Upton is in a courtyard.
Approach through grass or from the rooftops and try to kill him.
A cutscene stops it: Upton runs the local Assassin Bureau and Vance lied to you. Go to Upton at the Bureau.

blocks.text: Fighting the men is fine and makes the hideout easier to find.

items.text: Meet Upton at the Nassau Bureau and follow him to a vantage point.
Hide in nearby bushes and eavesdrop on Upton and Vance; follow Upton afterwards.
Kill Jing Lang's men around a house, garden guards first, then the pair at the entrance.
Search the house for Jing Lang's letter on a wooden crate; it says Vance took his half of the map to meet her.
Go to the tavern and eavesdrop on Vance and Jing Lang unseen; hiding under the wooden stairs beside it works.
Learn that Vance hired killers for Upton; return to the hideout, beat the soldiers and defend Upton.
Talk to Upton, who then heads to the tavern.

blocks.text: The next mission starts as soon as you speak to Upton, so do not linger.

items.text: Meet drunk Upton at the tavern; he starts a brawl.
Beat the attackers while keeping Upton safe.
Escort him home; when he stops for dancers, pay them 100 Reales.
Kill the guards drawn by Upton relieving himself in the street.
Talk to Upton to finish.

blocks.text: Carry at least 100 Reales first; the payment is required.
Queen of Pirates, King of Fools

items.text: Find sober Upton in the eastern swamp; he asks you to kill Vance and recover the key.
Move through the trees to bypass guards, killing those loading a boat if you wish.
Use Eagle Vision and look north for a green marker beside a white tent.
Clear guards near the tent and assassinate Vance; a sleep dart can knock him out first.
After the cutscene Jing Lang flees into the swamp; chase her until she stops to fight with two guards.
Defeat the guards, then kill Jing Lang to get the Templar Key.
Report back to Upton.

blocks.text: Jing Lang takes no damage while running, so save ammo.

pages.title: Templar hunt: Opia Anito
pages.summary: Opia is at Castillo de Jagua on Cayman Sound. The sources spell her name Apito. Hostile ships patrol the approach: sink them, or leave the Jackdaw 200 to 300 metres out and swim in.

items.value: Opia is at Castillo de Jagua on Cayman Sound. The sources spell her name Apito. Hostile ships patrol the approach: sink them, or leave the Jackdaw 200 to 300 metres out and swim in.
Digested Map Piece (mission 1) and the final Templar Key (fifth per the sources) from Lucia Marquez; completes all four hunts and the Damn Fine Gear side quest.

items.text: Greet Opia and follow her into the camp.
Use Eagle Vision on the tree with claw marks and the blood puddle; talk to Opia.
Follow the trail to the dead guards and take the right branch at the fork.
Kill the White Jaguar.
Watch the cutscene, then go to the docks in the far east of Castillo de Jagua near Grand Cayman.

blocks.text: Sleep dart then assassinate for a one-move kill.
Without darts use heavy attacks and dodge its charges.

items.text: Follow Opia to the Grand Cayman docks; she asks you to investigate the Templar presence.
Sit on the bench at the marker and listen to two locals talk about the King of Fishermen.
Go west to the Viewpoint and use Eagle Vision in the search zone to spot the King.
Tail him and pickpocket the Bill of Sale from behind.
Meet Opia east of Grand Cayman near the Viewpoint and hand it over.

blocks.text: If he sees you he turns hostile and you must fight him.

items.text: Opia explains that Vargas is Lucia Marquez's right hand and takes you to his house.
Hide in the hay bale across from his door; when Opia knocks, Vargas runs.
Chase him on foot; he escapes by ship, so pursue in the Jackdaw.
Damage his ship enough to board without sinking it.
Board and kill Vargas.

blocks.text: Too much cannon fire fails the objective.
Clearing the whole crew first can trigger a marker bug with no target; reload your last save.
Repair the Jackdaw before heading to Pinos Isle.

items.text: Meet Opia on the Pinos Isle beach and wait until night.
Go through the Templar camp with her, using bushes and shared takedowns on guards.
At the ziggurat ruins, kill all seven of Lucia's men; a second wave follows, so keep Opia safe.
Use Eagle Vision to find Lucia east of the ruins; she runs with two guards.
Clear her guards and kill her; hold the interact button to confirm.
Watch the cutscene and talk to Opia to close the hunt (final key).

blocks.text: Sleep darts thrown at clustered groups keep the ziggurat fight quiet.

pages.title: Former Glories
pages.summary: Added to the quest log once Great Inagua becomes your hideout; the butler Bernard Woodhouse introduces the rebuilding.

items.value: Added to the quest log once Great Inagua becomes your hideout; the butler Bernard Woodhouse introduces the rebuilding.
Finish the main mission This Old Cove.
Edward the Legend outfit (cosmetic only). Mapmaster lists the final butler meeting as a separate stage named A Finished Home, needing Former Glories plus all three Art Lover parts.

items.text: Capture Great Inagua so the hideout and manor become yours.
Restore the 7 village buildings: General Store, Tavern, Harbourmaster, Brothel, Campfire, Treasure Dealer, Fisherman's Wharf.
Buy all 3 Manor upgrades: Facade, Tower and Garden, Guesthouse.
Return to Bernard Woodhouse on the hill above the settlement to end the quest.

blocks.text: Only the first tier of the General Store and Harbourmaster counts toward the requirement; tiers II and III can wait.

Costs per one source (Reales): General Store 500/2,500/5,000; Tavern 100; Harbourmaster 500/2,500/5,000; Brothel 6,000; Campfire 6,000; Treasure Dealer 5,000; Fisherman's Wharf 5,000; Facade 4,000; Tower and Garden 8,000; Guesthouse 20,000.
Tier-one buildings plus the Manor come to about 55,100 Reales (one source's own sum).
Tavern first, since some buildings unlock only after others (Gamer Guides checklist).
Naval contract income helps pay for upgrades (Techwiser).

pages.title: Damn Fine Gear
pages.summary: A gated room with five locks in the Great Inagua manor (study, by the globe table); Kidd shows it and Edward opens one lock with a key taken from Julien du Casse.
pages.area: Great Inagua hideout (Manor); tied to Templar Hunts

items.value: A gated room with five locks in the Great Inagua manor (study, by the globe table); Kidd shows it and Edward opens one lock with a key taken from Julien du Casse.
Finish the main mission This Old Cove.
Templar Armor outfit, Templar Cross trinket (less melee damage taken), 10,000 Reales, 45 Bones.

items.text: Finish This Old Cove so the quest and the Templar Hunts appear.
Complete the four Templar Hunts in any order; each ends with killing a Templar who carries a key.
Collect the key from each hunt.
Return to the five-lock gate in the manor and open it with the four hunt keys plus du Casse's key.
Take the Templar Armor from the room behind the gate.

blocks.text: Start with whichever hunt is nearest your route to cut backtracking.
The 10,000 Reales can fund hideout upgrades.

Hand in 30 pieces to Bernard in the cave under the manor.

items.text: Find the stelae (16 in total) around the Caribbean, starting with the one on Great Inagua.
For each: climb the tallest totem, line the glowing outline up with nearby landmarks, and the buried stele location is revealed.
Gated stelae: Tulum (after Nothing is True), Isla Providencia (2, after Marooned), Long Bay (after The Observatory).

Place all the stelae in the door to open the deeper ruins.
Do easy platforming to the far chamber and claim the rewards.

Win the ship battle near the site: sink small boats, board to repair, wear down the largest ship, then dock at the bay.
Assassinate the searching pirates or fight them openly.
Dive and follow the jellyfish into the underwater cavern, dodging the shark.
In the first big room defeat the pirates, carry the powder keg to the rubble blocking the doorway, step back and shoot it.
In the next cave with a sloped floor defeat pirates, carry the keg up the slope to the rubble and shoot it open.
Open the treasure chest inside; a cutscene plays at Great Inagua.

blocks.text: Keep the Jackdaw's health high; the fort and pirate battle are the hardest parts.
Use small boats to repair mid-battle.
Stealth takedowns stop the searchers from starting a fight.

Return to the Revenge, unlock the hold and enter Bonnet's quarters.

pages.title: Rift: Wayward Souls
pages.summary: Opens after Sequence 4 (ending with the mission Overrun and Outnumbered). The game gives no notice; you must visit the spot. One source (Vandal) instead names the main quest This Old Cove as the unloc

items.value: Opens after Sequence 4 (ending with the mission Overrun and Outnumbered). The game gives no notice; you must visit the spot. One source (Vandal) instead names the main quest This Old Cove as the unlock.

Southern tip of Great Inagua, map coordinates 825, 429 (VGC, ConsolePulse, GamerGuides). Reachable by sailing the Jackdaw round the south coast, or on foot across the island (large drop at the end; roll before landing). A purple Animus icon shows on the HUD and map on arrival. Another source describes it as an island off the south coast with floating rocks visible from afar.
Lock of Hair, a Rare trinket that restores a little health after a Perfect Parry. The Eagle route gives an extra 5,000 Reales (ConsolePulse). Counts toward the 300 Keys bonus for all four Rifts.

items.text: Go to the marker and start the quest; you may leave it in the log and return later.
Step through the portal; no gear prep is needed.
Pick up the treasure chest and keep carrying it; health drains while you are not holding it.
At each blocked path, put the chest down, jump to the ship wheel (beams of light point at wheels) and turn it, then grab the chest again.
The second stop needs two wheels; the third stop needs a climb or pond route and a lift plus zipline back to the chest.
When the floor is covered in spikes, jump forward; a safe platform appears if you trust Ego.
Choice at the end: trust Ego and wait for the shorter ending, or follow the Eagle into a Leap of Faith for the longer route.
Longer route: a fast underwater ride; steer left and right early to dodge the jellyfish-like walls, then climb out without the chest while health drains.
Finish with the Ego dialogue about Edward keeping his promise to Caroline; you return to Great Inagua.

blocks.text: Follow the beams of light to find the next wheel quickly.
Keep moving at all times while the chest is not in your hands.
Start moving sideways as you reach each group of tentacles in the fast section.
Keys lie along the route to the Rift and count toward the Animus Hub Exchange.

pages.title: Rift: Wayward Desires

items.value: Opens after Sequence 8 (Do Not Go Gently; VGC also calls it Blackbeard's Death). GamerGuides-style source says 'after starting Sequence 8'.

Legendary Queen Anne's Revenge Wheel for the Jackdaw.

items.text: Restock pistol ammo and Remedies first.
Resynchronize at the tomb, then with the figure who comes out, and jump from the ship bow.
Cross the ships, defeating enemies; shoot ranged enemies first and use swivel guns and red explosive barrels on groups.
Use ziplines, then land on the cannonballs when you drop to the platform.
Swim the whirlpool section, steering clear of red barrels; cannon-fire section: dodge shots and avoid danger areas.
Fight Blackbeard: dodge heavy attacks and punish the recovery; he vanishes after losing about a quarter of health.
Final arena: thin out his crew with barrels, swivel guns and quick shots, then focus on him; several pistol shots break his guard for a takedown.
Climb the mast and swap the Jolly Roger for the British flag; resynchronize to finish.

blocks.text: Ranged attacks are safer because the white setting hides enemy attack indicators.
Move out of the danger circles at once.
If the second zipline fails to appear, update the game (Title Update 1.0.4 is said to fix it).

items.text: Advance and defeat the enemies; at the first gate aim by hand at the visible enemies rather than using automatic quick shots.
If an enemy carries a musket, shoot him or get close to him.
Spare the guard beside the climbable wall so the route opens.
Edward gives up his pistols at a grave and later his swords, turning the Rift into a stealth challenge.
Do not assassinate the sniper over the final bridge; climb the stairs first.
Stealth part: avoid guards and floating spotlights (being seen fails the Rift); move between flower beds and reeds as the light passes, using the barn roof and ledges.
Pass the gate and sprint-jump the narrow last stretch before the spotlight catches up.
Interact with Mary's silhouette and choose Renounce the Creed.

blocks.text: Do not kill the guard by the wall or the final sniper; if the route stays shut or resets, reload the checkpoint and spare them.
Keep two rotating manual saves before this Rift and before True Purpose.

items.value: After finishing the story through the Epilogue (Ever a Splinter), plus the first three Rifts per ConsolePulse. Another source says to reload your save after the story ends.
Island east of Misteriosa and northeast of Fort Serranilla, coordinates 363, 176. Waters are stormy, so repair and resupply the Jackdaw first.
Legendary Dark Animus Corsair Pistol Swords, whose heavy attacks fire free shots. Finishing all four Rifts also gives 300 Animus Keys.

items.text: Sail to the island with a repaired, resupplied ship.
At the theater choice only two options appear and neither progresses; wait through the crow and Eagle dialogue until a third option, Fight Back, shows up and pick it.
On the rafters, kill ranged enemies first because their shots can knock Edward off.
Use the hooks to lift stage scenery and reveal the route.
Collect Remedies before the boss.
Fight Ego's Emotion Agent in two phases: dodge big attacks, break the guard with pistol quick shots, then take it down in the opening.
Save Remedies and bullets for the second phase.

blocks.text: Boss moves: whirlwind (dodge and punish), ground pound (leave the ring), ground fracture (use the gaps), anomaly shield (avoid the four blocks), searing stones (five rocks in phase two), chaos beam (fires three times; wait out the third).
Pattern that works: dodge, shoot during recovery, takedown, reset distance.

Wayward Souls at Great Inagua south (825, 429); Wayward Desires north of Nassau (604, 784); Wayward Minds at Sacrifice Island northwest (14, 559); True Purpose east of Misteriosa (363, 176).

pages.title: Animus hub and projects
pages.summary: How the Animus hub, projects and data fragments work.

items.text: The Animus Hub holds the Rift quests and an Exchange store that Keys are spent in; the stock of the store was not described.
Keys can be found in the world, including along the route to Wayward Souls.
Finishing all four Rifts gives 300 Keys, which must be claimed by hand: Animus Hub, Synchronization section.
If the all-Rifts goal will not complete, check the four individual rewards are owned, then restart and look again; some players report tracking bugs.
Animus Projects: a free battle-pass style system that you spend Data Fragments in.
Data Fragments: a live-service currency earned from timed Anomaly challenges that spawn periodically on the Caribbean Sea map (white Animus icons that turn purple when selected).
Anomaly types: sinking corrupted ships, opening corrupted chests, defeating corrupted entities.
Each completed Anomaly gives 700 to 900 Data Fragments; Rifts also give some.
Project rewards: cosmetics, Animus Keys and exclusive gear, such as Dark Animus Corsair Flintlocks and Corsair Robes from the Eye in the Dark Project.
The four story Rifts do not need Data Fragments.
Vault Data Files are separate: about 35 fixed-location modern-day lore collectibles that each unlock an Animus database entry. A few need level gates in the Riptides Animus Project or story progress.
Fragment sets named by one source: The Journey, The Watchers, Devils of the Caribbean, Ego, Breach.

items.label: El Impoluto
items.detail: Map coords 117, 841. It rams head-on, then circles just outside your cannon range. Needs: No level gate; a fully upgraded ship and all officers are recommended Reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: copy its pattern - ram it back, fire Burning Shot before leaving its range, use the mortar while out of range, then ram again; brace to soak damage.

items.label: La Dama Negra
items.detail: Map coords 240, 72. Relies on mortar barrages; generally the easiest legendary ship. Needs: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended Reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: stay close, fire Heated Shot broadsides and brace right after; fire your own mortar when it stops to set up its mortar.

items.label: HMS Prince
items.detail: Map coords 854, 55. Has three health phases and hides in fog between them. Needs: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended Reward: Money and a legendary ship cosmetic. How to beat: at close-to-medium range use Heated Shot and brace while it reloads. After each phase it vanishes in fog and mortars you for one to two minutes - sail

Needs: No level gate; fully upgraded ship and all officers recommended Reward: Money and legendary ship cosmetics (source does not split rewards between the two). How to beat: fire the mortar while they turn, Ram-Dash one ship, brace against its cannons and hit its back with Bur

Former Glories
items.detail: Reward: Edward the Legend outfit (cosmetic only). Mapmaster lists the final butler meeting as a separate stage named A Finished Home, needing Former Glories plus all three Art Lover parts.

items.label: Damn Fine Gear
items.detail: Reward: Templar Armor outfit, Templar Cross trinket (less melee damage taken), 10,000 Reales, 45 Bones.
items.area: Great Inagua hideout (Manor); tied to Templar Hunts

items.label: Art Lover
items.detail: Reward: 15 pieces: Found Coin, Le Bourgeoys Blades. 25 pieces: Aquila Figurehead, Aquila's Sails, Aquila's Wheel. 30 pieces: 4,000 Reales, Master Assassin Outfit, Obsidian Hull (Mapmaster adds Paddy Layback Shanty).

items.label: Mayan Mysteries
items.detail: Reward: Mayan Outfit (cosmetic), Yax Tun Pendant (reportedly absorbs gunshots).

items.label: Blackbeard's Treasure
items.detail: Reward: Blackbeard's Portrait. One source also mentions 4,962 Reales and a Weather Map Piece from the nearby chest.

items.label: Captain Stede Bonnet
items.detail: Reward: Stede Bonnet's Portrait; Stede Bonnet's Dagger and a sea shanty per Techwiser and Mapmaster. Gamer Guides lists no gameplay rewards.

items.label: Cat Distribution System
items.detail: Reward: Soot the Cat, a cosmetic pet for the Jackdaw.

items.label: Monkey Business
items.detail: Reward: Albert the Monkey, a cosmetic pet for the Jackdaw.

items.label: A Proper Shipwright
items.detail: Reward: Lucy joins as Shipwright officer.

items.label: The One With the Gun
items.detail: Reward: Perfect Brace ship ability (greatly cuts incoming ship damage when timed well); ConsolePulse also lists Black Ship's Sails.

items.label: Plantain!
items.detail: Reward: Baldwin's Golden Pistols (equip from inventory); described as better than the starting pistols but weaker than Deluxe or later weapons.

items.label: Big Wig
items.detail: Reward: Completes her questline; ConsolePulse lists the Neatly Folded Letter.

items.label: A Second Chance
items.detail: Reward: Starts his recruitment chain; no item named.

items.label: Loyalty, Discipline, and Courage
items.detail: Reward: Ram Dash ship ability (charge into enemies, has a cooldown); upgradeable at the Great Inagua Harbormaster. Padre is recruited.

items.label: If Thy Right Hand Offend Thee
items.detail: Reward: None listed.

items.label: The Other Cheek
items.detail: Reward: Small Goblet trinket (one caption calls it Small Chalice).

items.label: No Box Dark Enough
items.detail: Reward: None listed for this quest.

items.label: All Love Must End
items.detail: Reward: None listed; his house unlocks the final quest.

items.label: Very Little, But Something
items.detail: Reward: Deadman's Cohort Mortar (faster, manually aimed mortar mode with a trail effect). Extra Salvo is granted earlier when he joins.

items.label: Wayward Souls
items.detail: Reward: Lock of Hair, a Rare trinket that restores a little health after a Perfect Parry. The Eagle route gives an extra 5,000 Reales (ConsolePulse). Counts toward the 300 Keys bonus for all four Rifts.

items.label: Wayward Desires
items.detail: Reward: Legendary Queen Anne's Revenge Wheel for the Jackdaw.

items.label: Wayward Minds
items.detail: Reward: The Don't Forget Your Old Shipmate sea shanty (sheet music).

items.label: True Purpose
items.detail: Reward: Legendary Dark Animus Corsair Pistol Swords, whose heavy attacks fire free shots. Finishing all four Rifts also gives 300 Animus Keys.

items.label: Dark Animus: Dark Animus questline (same four quests as the Rifts)
items.detail: Reward: Completing all four grants the Dark Animus Corsair Pistol Swords (VGC); ConsolePulse says that comes from True Purpose itself and that all four give 300 Keys.
